# Cal/OSHA Heat Illness Prevention Training for Construction

> 1-hour online course for construction personnel working indoors and outdoors on recognizing, preventing and responding to heat illness, and on implementing a Heat Illness Prevention Plan (HIPP). In accordance with Cal/OSHA Title 8, Sections 3395 (outdoor) and 3396 (indoor), and the OSH Act General Duty Clause, Section 5(a)(1). Offered by HAZWOPER OSHA Training (https://hazwoper-osha.com).

## Key facts
- Regulations: Cal/OSHA Title 8 §3395 and §3396; OSH Act General Duty Clause 5(a)(1)
- Duration: about 1 hour; 4 lessons plus final exam
- Credits: 0.1 CEU
- Price: $47.99 per person online; bulk pricing from 2 seats
- Delivery: 100% online, 24/7, mobile-optimized, SCORM-compliant; English and Spanish
- Completion window: 3 months; 1 year of access to materials
- Certificate: instant PDF on passing, valid 12 months
- Refresher: required every 12 months
- Prerequisites: none

## Topics
Heat cramps, heat exhaustion and heat stroke; signs and symptoms; risk factors (temperature, humidity, exertion, clothing and PPE); hydration, rest breaks, shade and cool-down areas; acclimatization for new or returning workers; the Heat Illness Prevention Plan; employer and supervisor responsibilities; emergency response.

## Who it is for
Outdoor workers (construction, landscaping, agriculture, delivery), indoor workers in hot areas (factories, warehouses, maintenance, kitchens), supervisors and managers, safety professionals, new and seasonal workers, and outdoor volunteers.

## Lessons
1. Heat Introduction
2. Heat Exhaustion
3. Heat Stress
4. Cal/OSHA Regulations
